verses.original: יְהוָ֣ה מָ֭לָךְ עַמִּ֑ים יִרְגְּז֣וּ יֹשֵׁ֥ב כְּ֝רוּבִ֗ים הָאָֽרֶץ׃ תָּנ֥וּט
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh mā·lāḵ ‘am·mîm yir·gə·zū yō·šêḇ kə·rū·ḇîm hā·’ā·reṣ tā·nūṭ
verses.literal: The LORD reigns let the nations tremble He is enthroned above the cherubim let the earth quake

verses.original: גָּד֑וֹל יְ֭הוָה בְּצִיּ֣וֹן ה֝֗וּא וְרָ֥ם עַל־ כָּל־ הָֽעַמִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: gā·ḏō·wl Yah·weh bə·ṣî·yō·wn hū wə·rām ‘al- kāl- hā·‘am·mîm
verses.literal: Great is the LORD in Zion He is exalted above all the peoples

verses.original: יוֹד֣וּ גָּד֥וֹל וְנוֹרָ֗א שִׁ֭מְךָ הֽוּא׃ קָד֥וֹשׁ
verses.transliteration: yō·w·ḏū gā·ḏō·wl wə·nō·w·rā šim·k̲ā hū qā·ḏō·wōš
verses.literal: Let them praise Your great and awesome name He is holy

verses.original: וְעֹ֥ז מֶלֶךְ֮ אָ֫הֵ֥ב מִשְׁפָּ֪ט אַ֭תָּה כּוֹנַ֣נְתָּ מֵישָׁרִ֑ים אַתָּ֬ה עָשִֽׂיתָ׃ מִשְׁפָּ֥ט וּ֝צְדָקָ֗ה בְּיַעֲקֹ֤ב׀
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ōz me·leḵ ’ā·hêḇ miš·pāṭ ’at·tāh kō·w·nan·tā mê·šā·rîm ’at·tāh ‘ā·śî·ṯā miš·pāṭ ū·ṣə·ḏā·qāh bə·ya·‘ă·qōḇ
verses.literal: The mighty King loves justice You have established equity You have exercised justice and righteousness in Jacob

verses.original: רֽוֹמְמ֡וּ יְה֘וָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ וְֽ֭הִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לַהֲדֹ֥ם רַגְלָ֗יו הֽוּא׃ קָד֥וֹשׁ
verses.transliteration: rō·wm·mū Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū wə·hiš·ta·ḥă·wū la·hă·ḏōm raḡ·lāw hū qā·ḏō·wōš
verses.literal: Exalt the LORD our God and worship at His footstool He is holy

verses.original: מֹ֘שֶׁ֤ה וְאַהֲרֹ֨ן׀ בְּֽכֹהֲנָ֗יו וּ֭שְׁמוּאֵל בְּקֹרְאֵ֣י שְׁמ֑וֹ קֹרִ֥אים אֶל־ יְ֝הוָ֗ה וְה֣וּא יַעֲנֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: mō·šeh wə·’a·hă·rōn bə·ḵō·hă·nāw ū·šə·mū·’êl bə·qō·rə·’ê šə·mōw qō·rim ’el- Yah·weh wə·hū ya·‘ă·nêm
verses.literal: Moses and Aaron were among His priests Samuel was among those who called on His name They called to the LORD and He answered

verses.original: יְדַבֵּ֣ר אֲלֵיהֶ֑ם בְּעַמּ֣וּד עָ֭נָן שָׁמְר֥וּ עֵ֝דֹתָ֗יו וְחֹ֣ק נָֽתַן־ לָֽמוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: yə·ḏab·bêr ’ă·lê·hem bə·‘am·mūḏ ‘ā·nān šā·mə·rū ‘ê·ḏō·ṯāw wə·ḥōq nā·ṯan- lā·mōw
verses.literal: He spoke to them from the pillar of cloud they kept His decrees and the statutes He gave them

verses.original: יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵינוּ֮ אַתָּ֪ה עֲנִ֫יתָ֥ם הָיִ֣יתָ נֹ֭שֵׂא אֵ֣ל לָהֶ֑ם וְ֝נֹקֵ֗ם עַל־ עֲלִילוֹתָֽם׃
verses.literal: O LORD our God You answered them You were a forgiving God to them yet an avenger of their misdeeds

verses.original: רֽוֹמְמ֡וּ יְה֘וָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ וְ֭הִֽשְׁתַּחֲווּ קָדְשׁ֑וֹ לְהַ֣ר כִּֽי־ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃ קָ֝ד֗וֹשׁ
verses.transliteration: rō·wm·mū Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū wə·hiš·ta·ḥă·wū qā·ḏə·šōw lə·har kî- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū qā·ḏō·wōš
verses.literal: Exalt the LORD our God and worship at His holy mountain for the LORD our God is holy
